papers.title: HD-AIP: A Heterogeneous Dual-Stream Alignment-Free Framework for Anti-Inflammatory Peptide Prediction Based on Language Models and CT-Net
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Anti-inflammatory peptides (AIPs) show therapeutic potential for treating chronic and autoimmune diseases. Computational screening of these peptides remains challenging because their typically short sequences limit traditional feature extraction effectiveness, while homology-based methods incur high computational costs. Results This study proposes HD-AIP, an alignment-free heterogeneous dual-stream prediction architecture. This framework extracts peptide features in parallel from both macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. Macroscopically, HD-AIP integrates global semantic features extracted by two large protein language models, ProtT5 and ESM-2 3B, with sequence-level physicochemical properties, followed by feature selection and LightGBM classification. Microscopically, an asymmetric parallel network named CT-Net utilizes BioVec embeddings and residue-level physicochemical features, using a CNN branch to capture local motifs and a Transformer branch to model long-range dependencies. The two streams are adaptively fused via a dynamic soft ensemble strategy. On an independent test set, HD-AIP outperforms baseline models across multiple metrics including accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, and the Matthews correlation coefficient. These results indicate that HD-AIP improves AIP prediction performance without sequence alignment. This architecture serves as an effective computational tool for the high-throughput virtual screening and candidate discovery of AIPs. Availability You can find the source code and dataset needed on GitHub( https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP ). The required package files have been listed in the readme
papers.abstract:
MOTIVATION: Anti-inflammatory peptides (AIPs) show therapeutic potential for treating chronic and autoimmune diseases. Computational screening of these peptides remains challenging because their typically short sequences limit traditional feature extraction effectiveness, while homology-based methods incur high computational costs.

RESULTS: This study proposes HD-AIP, an alignment-free heterogeneous dual-stream prediction architecture. This framework extracts peptide features in parallel from both macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. Macroscopically, HD-AIP integrates global semantic features extracted by two large protein language models, ProtT5 and ESM-2 3B, with sequence-level physicochemical properties, followed by feature selection and LightGBM classification. Microscopically, an asymmetric parallel network named CT-Net utilizes BioVec embeddings and residue-level physicochemical features, using a CNN branch to capture local motifs and a Transformer branch to model long-range dependencies. The two streams are adaptively fused via a dynamic soft ensemble strategy. On an independent test set, HD-AIP outperforms baseline models across multiple metrics including accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, and the Matthews correlation coefficient. These results indicate that HD-AIP improves AIP prediction performance without sequence alignment. This architecture serves as an effective computational tool for the high-throughput virtual screening and candidate discovery of AIPs.

AVAILABILITY: You can find the source code and dataset needed on GitHub(https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP). The required package files have been listed in the readme.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

llm_highlights_zh: 对这些肽进行计算筛选仍然具有挑战性，因为它们通常具有较短的序列长度，这使得传统的特征提取方法难以发挥有效作用；而基于同源性分析的方法则会导致较高的计算成本。

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
抗炎肽在治疗慢性疾病和自身免疫性疾病方面展现出潜在的治疗效果。然而，针对这些肽的计算筛选工作仍面临诸多挑战：由于其序列通常较短，传统的特征提取方法效果有限；而基于同源性分析的方法则会导致较高的计算成本。  

**研究结果**  
本研究提出了HD-AIP这一无需序列比对的异构双流预测框架。该框架从宏观与微观两个层面并行提取肽的特征：在宏观层面上，HD-AIP结合了两种大型蛋白质语言模型ProtT5和ESM-2 3B所提取的全局语义信息以及序列层面的理化性质，随后通过特征选择和LightGBM分类算法进行后续处理；在微观层面上，CT-Net这一非对称并行网络利用BioVec嵌入技术和残基级别的理化性质，其中CNN分支用于捕捉局部结构特征，Transformer分支则用于模拟长距离的相互作用。这两种特征流通过动态软集成策略被有效融合。在独立的测试数据集上，HD-AIP在准确性、接收者操作特征曲线下面积以及Matthews相关系数等多个指标上均优于传统模型。这些结果表明，HD-AIP能够在无需序列比对的情况下显著提升抗炎肽的预测性能。该框架为抗炎肽的高通量虚拟筛选与候选分子发现提供了有效的计算工具。  

**代码与数据集获取方式**  
源代码及所需的数据集可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP。相关依赖包文件已列在readme文件中。

papers.title: GlycoViz: A glycoproteomics tool for validating and visualizing glycopeptide identifications
papers.summary: Abstract Summary GlycoViz is an open-source algorithm and software tool designed to address critical bottlenecks in the post-identification workflow of mass spectrometry-based glycoproteomics. Current glyco search engines excel at glycopeptide identification but there is a lack of tools for robust post-identification validation, global glycan composition statistics, and reliable site-specific analysis, particularly concerning false positives and quantification distortion due to shallow detection depth. GlycoViz offers an alternative solution with a novel glycopeptide validation algorithm that is compatible with data from multiple search engines. Analysis of N-linked glycans is fully supported whereas O-linked glycan data analysis is limited primarily to visualization and non-optimized validation. Availability The open-source software is available on GitHub at https://github.com/calico/glycoviz . It can be launched as local software through Docker Compose or hosted as a web application in a server. A snapshot of the code is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123
papers.abstract:
SUMMARY: GlycoViz is an open-source algorithm and software tool designed to address critical bottlenecks in the post-identification workflow of mass spectrometry-based glycoproteomics. Current glyco search engines excel at glycopeptide identification but there is a lack of tools for robust post-identification validation, global glycan composition statistics, and reliable site-specific analysis, particularly concerning false positives and quantification distortion due to shallow detection depth. GlycoViz offers an alternative solution with a novel glycopeptide validation algorithm that is compatible with data from multiple search engines. Analysis of N-linked glycans is fully supported whereas O-linked glycan data analysis is limited primarily to visualization and non-optimized validation.

AVAILABILITY: The open-source software is available on GitHub at https://github.com/calico/glycoviz. It can be launched as local software through Docker Compose or hosted as a web application in a server. A snapshot of the code is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 摘要：GlycoViz是一种开源算法及软件工具，专为解决基于质谱技术的糖蛋白组学分析中后鉴定阶段所存在的关键瓶颈而设计。
llm_highlights_zh: 目前的糖链分析工具在识别糖肽方面表现优异，但缺乏用于后续验证、全面分析糖链组成以及进行特定位点分析的工具。尤其是对于那些由于检测深度不足而导致的假阳性结果及定量偏差问题，目前仍缺乏有效的解决方法。
GlycoViz提供了一种替代方案，该方案采用了新型的糖肽验证算法，能够兼容来自多种搜索引擎的数据。
N连接糖链的分析得到了全面的支持，而O连接糖链的数据分析则主要局限于可视化展示及未经优化的验证过程。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：GlycoViz是一种开源算法及软件工具，旨在解决基于质谱技术的糖蛋白组学分析中后鉴定环节所存在的关键问题。现有的糖链搜索引擎在糖肽识别方面表现优异，但缺乏用于进行严格后鉴定验证、全面分析糖链组成以及进行可靠位点特异性分析的工具——尤其是那些能够有效应对假阳性结果及由于检测深度不足导致的定量偏差的问题。GlycoViz提供了一种替代方案，它采用了全新的糖肽验证算法，并且能够兼容多种搜索引擎生成的数据。该工具可完整支持N-连接糖链的分析，而O-连接糖链的数据分析目前主要局限于可视化展示及非优化的验证流程。  

获取方式：这款开源软件可在GitHub上下载，地址为https://github.com/calico/glycoviz。用户可以通过Docker Compose将其作为本地软件运行，也可将其部署为服务器端Web应用程序使用。该软件的代码快照也存储在Zenodo平台上，链接为：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123。

papers.primary_summary_raw:
SUMMARY: GlycoViz is an open-source algorithm and software tool designed to address critical bottlenecks in the post-identification workflow of mass spectrometry-based glycoproteomics. Current glyco search engines excel at glycopeptide identification but there is a lack of tools for robust post-identification validation, global glycan composition statistics, and reliable site-specific analysis, particularly concerning false positives and quantification distortion due to shallow detection depth. GlycoViz offers an alternative solution with a novel glycopeptide validation algorithm that is compatible with data from multiple search engines. Analysis of N-linked glycans is fully supported whereas O-linked glycan data analysis is limited primarily to visualization and non-optimized validation.

AVAILABILITY: The open-source software is available on GitHub at https://github.com/calico/glycoviz. It can be launched as local software through Docker Compose or hosted as a web application in a server. A snapshot of the code is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

all_papers.title: HD-AIP: A Heterogeneous Dual-Stream Alignment-Free Framework for Anti-Inflammatory Peptide Prediction Based on Language Models and CT-Net
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Anti-inflammatory peptides (AIPs) show therapeutic potential for treating chronic and autoimmune diseases. Computational screening of these peptides remains challenging because their typically short sequences limit traditional feature extraction effectiveness, while homology-based methods incur high computational costs. Results This study proposes HD-AIP, an alignment-free heterogeneous dual-stream prediction architecture. This framework extracts peptide features in parallel from both macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. Macroscopically, HD-AIP integrates global semantic features extracted by two large protein language models, ProtT5 and ESM-2 3B, with sequence-level physicochemical properties, followed by feature selection and LightGBM classification. Microscopically, an asymmetric parallel network named CT-Net utilizes BioVec embeddings and residue-level physicochemical features, using a CNN branch to capture local motifs and a Transformer branch to model long-range dependencies. The two streams are adaptively fused via a dynamic soft ensemble strategy. On an independent test set, HD-AIP outperforms baseline models across multiple metrics including accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, and the Matthews correlation coefficient. These results indicate that HD-AIP improves AIP prediction performance without sequence alignment. This architecture serves as an effective computational tool for the high-throughput virtual screening and candidate discovery of AIPs. Availability You can find the source code and dataset needed on GitHub( https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP ). The required package files have been listed in the readme

all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
抗炎肽在治疗慢性疾病和自身免疫性疾病方面展现出潜在的治疗效果。然而，针对这些肽的计算筛选工作仍面临诸多挑战：由于其序列通常较短，传统的特征提取方法效果有限；而基于同源性分析的方法则会导致较高的计算成本。  

**研究结果**  
本研究提出了HD-AIP这一无需序列比对的异构双流预测框架。该框架从宏观与微观两个层面并行提取肽的特征：在宏观层面上，HD-AIP结合了两种大型蛋白质语言模型ProtT5和ESM-2 3B所提取的全局语义信息以及序列层面的理化性质，随后通过特征选择和LightGBM分类算法进行后续处理；在微观层面上，CT-Net这一非对称并行网络利用BioVec嵌入技术和残基级别的理化性质，其中CNN分支用于捕捉局部结构特征，Transformer分支则用于模拟长距离的相互作用。这两种特征流通过动态软集成策略被有效融合。在独立的测试数据集上，HD-AIP在准确性、接收者操作特征曲线下面积以及Matthews相关系数等多个指标上均优于传统模型。这些结果表明，HD-AIP能够在无需序列比对的情况下显著提升抗炎肽的预测性能。该框架为抗炎肽的高通量虚拟筛选与候选分子发现提供了有效的计算工具。  

**代码与数据集获取方式**  
源代码及所需的数据集可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP。相关依赖包文件已列在readme文件中。
all_papers.llm_pubmed_abstract_zh:
**动机**：抗炎肽在治疗慢性疾病和自身免疫性疾病方面展现出潜在的治疗效果。然而，针对这些肽的计算筛选工作仍面临诸多挑战——由于它们的序列通常较短，传统特征提取方法的效果有限；而基于同源性分析的方法则会导致较高的计算成本。  

**结果**：本研究提出了一种名为HD-AIP的预测框架。该框架采用无序列比对的双流并行处理机制，从宏观与微观两个层面同时提取肽的特征。在宏观层面上，HD-AIP结合了两种大型蛋白质语言模型ProtT5和ESM-2 3B所提取的全局语义信息，以及序列层面的理化性质数据，随后通过特征选择和LightGBM分类算法进行后续处理；在微观层面上，CT-Net这一非对称并行网络利用BioVec嵌入技术和残基级别的理化性质信息，其中CNN分支用于捕捉局部结构特征，Transformer分支则用于模拟长距离的序列依赖关系。这两种特征流通过动态软集成策略被有机结合在一起。在独立的测试数据集上，HD-AIP在准确性、接收者操作特征曲线下面积以及Matthews相关系数等多个评估指标上均优于传统模型。这些结果表明，HD-AIP能够在无需序列比对的情况下显著提升抗炎肽的预测性能。这一框架为抗炎肽的高通量虚拟筛选与候选分子发现提供了有效的计算工具。  

**代码与数据集获取方式**：源代码及所需的数据集可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP。相关依赖包文件的信息已记录在readme文件中。  

**补充信息**：更多补充数据可在线查阅Bioinformatics数据库。

all_papers.primary_summary_raw:
MOTIVATION: Anti-inflammatory peptides (AIPs) show therapeutic potential for treating chronic and autoimmune diseases. Computational screening of these peptides remains challenging because their typically short sequences limit traditional feature extraction effectiveness, while homology-based methods incur high computational costs.

RESULTS: This study proposes HD-AIP, an alignment-free heterogeneous dual-stream prediction architecture. This framework extracts peptide features in parallel from both macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. Macroscopically, HD-AIP integrates global semantic features extracted by two large protein language models, ProtT5 and ESM-2 3B, with sequence-level physicochemical properties, followed by feature selection and LightGBM classification. Microscopically, an asymmetric parallel network named CT-Net utilizes BioVec embeddings and residue-level physicochemical features, using a CNN branch to capture local motifs and a Transformer branch to model long-range dependencies. The two streams are adaptively fused via a dynamic soft ensemble strategy. On an independent test set, HD-AIP outperforms baseline models across multiple metrics including accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, and the Matthews correlation coefficient. These results indicate that HD-AIP improves AIP prediction performance without sequence alignment. This architecture serves as an effective computational tool for the high-throughput virtual screening and candidate discovery of AIPs.

AVAILABILITY: You can find the source code and dataset needed on GitHub(https://github.com/Zerofly0/HD-AIP). The required package files have been listed in the readme.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

all_papers.title: GlycoViz: A glycoproteomics tool for validating and visualizing glycopeptide identifications
all_papers.summary: Abstract Summary GlycoViz is an open-source algorithm and software tool designed to address critical bottlenecks in the post-identification workflow of mass spectrometry-based glycoproteomics. Current glyco search engines excel at glycopeptide identification but there is a lack of tools for robust post-identification validation, global glycan composition statistics, and reliable site-specific analysis, particularly concerning false positives and quantification distortion due to shallow detection depth. GlycoViz offers an alternative solution with a novel glycopeptide validation algorithm that is compatible with data from multiple search engines. Analysis of N-linked glycans is fully supported whereas O-linked glycan data analysis is limited primarily to visualization and non-optimized validation. Availability The open-source software is available on GitHub at https://github.com/calico/glycoviz . It can be launched as local software through Docker Compose or hosted as a web application in a server. A snapshot of the code is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123
all_papers.abstract:

Current glyco search engines excel at glycopeptide identification but there is a lack of tools for robust post-identification validation, global glycan composition statistics, and reliable site-specific analysis, particularly concerning false positives and quantification distortion due to shallow detection depth. GlycoViz offers an alternative solution with a novel glycopeptide validation algorithm that is compatible with data from multiple search engines. Analysis of N-linked glycans is fully supported whereas O-linked glycan data analysis is limited primarily to visualization and non-optimized validation.

AVAILABILITY: The open-source software is available on GitHub at https://github.com/calico/glycoviz. It can be launched as local software through Docker Compose or hosted as a web application in a server. A snapshot of the code is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123.

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 摘要：GlycoViz是一种开源算法及软件工具，专为解决基于质谱技术的糖蛋白组学分析中后鉴定阶段所存在的关键瓶颈而设计。
llm_highlights_zh: 目前的糖链分析工具在识别糖肽方面表现优异，但缺乏用于后续验证、全面分析糖链组成以及进行特定位点分析的工具。尤其是对于那些由于检测深度不足而导致的假阳性结果及定量偏差问题，目前仍缺乏有效的解决方法。
GlycoViz提供了一种替代方案，该方案采用了新型的糖肽验证算法，能够兼容来自多种搜索引擎的数据。
N连接糖链的分析得到了全面的支持，而O连接糖链的数据分析则主要局限于可视化展示及未经优化的验证过程。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：GlycoViz是一种开源算法及软件工具，旨在解决基于质谱技术的糖蛋白组学分析中后鉴定环节所存在的关键问题。现有的糖链搜索引擎在糖肽识别方面表现优异，但缺乏用于进行严格后鉴定验证、全面分析糖链组成以及进行可靠位点特异性分析的工具——尤其是那些能够有效应对假阳性结果及由于检测深度不足导致的定量偏差的问题。GlycoViz提供了一种替代方案，它采用了全新的糖肽验证算法，并且能够兼容多种搜索引擎生成的数据。该工具可完整支持N-连接糖链的分析，而O-连接糖链的数据分析目前主要局限于可视化展示及非优化的验证流程。  

获取方式：这款开源软件可在GitHub上下载，地址为https://github.com/calico/glycoviz。用户可以通过Docker Compose将其作为本地软件运行，也可将其部署为服务器端Web应用程序使用。该软件的代码快照也存储在Zenodo平台上，链接为：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22680123。
